category_description: Saving, investing and protecting your money in the United States.
subcategory_description: The limits and rules for IRAs and workplace retirement plans.
label: IRA contribution limit
context: The most you can contribute to all of your traditional and Roth IRAs combined for the year.

label: IRA catch-up contribution limit, age 50 and over
context: Added to the IRA contribution limit for people aged 50 and over. It adjusts with inflation under SECURE 2.0.

label: Traditional IRA deduction phase-out, single, covered by a workplace plan, bottom of range
context: The deduction for traditional IRA contributions is reduced across this income range and eliminated at the top.

label: Traditional IRA deduction phase-out, single, covered by a workplace plan, top of range
context: The deduction for traditional IRA contributions is reduced across this income range and eliminated at the top.

label: Traditional IRA deduction phase-out, married filing jointly, contributor covered by a workplace plan, bottom of range
context: Applies to a married couple filing jointly when the spouse making the IRA contribution is covered by a workplace retirement plan.

label: Traditional IRA deduction phase-out, married filing jointly, contributor covered by a workplace plan, top of range
context: Applies to a married couple filing jointly when the spouse making the IRA contribution is covered by a workplace retirement plan.

label: Traditional IRA deduction phase-out, contributor not covered but spouse is, bottom of range
context: Applies to an IRA contributor who is not covered by a workplace plan but is married to someone who is.

label: Traditional IRA deduction phase-out, contributor not covered but spouse is, top of range
context: Applies to an IRA contributor who is not covered by a workplace plan but is married to someone who is.

label: Roth IRA phase-out, single and head of household, bottom of range
context: Eligibility to contribute directly to a Roth IRA is reduced across this income range and eliminated at the top.

label: Roth IRA phase-out, single and head of household, top of range
context: Eligibility to contribute directly to a Roth IRA is reduced across this income range and eliminated at the top.

label: Roth IRA phase-out, married filing jointly, bottom of range
context: Eligibility to contribute directly to a Roth IRA is reduced across this income range and eliminated at the top.

label: Roth IRA phase-out, married filing jointly, top of range
context: Eligibility to contribute directly to a Roth IRA is reduced across this income range and eliminated at the top.

subject_intro: How much you can put into IRAs, the catch-up amount for people over 50, and the income ranges that limit Roth contributions and traditional IRA deductions.
subject_meta_description: The IRA contribution limit is {fact:us_ira_limit} for {tax_year}, with a catch-up for ages 50 and over. See the income phase-outs for Roth IRAs and deductions.
